⚡ BITLOCK ⚡UPDATE 6 AND 7 NOW!!!!
One life per legend. Make the name heavy.
Live an entire striker's life, from your first touch in the backyard to the top of the world rankings. Every year is a choice. Every match is a choice worth taking.

🍼 CREATE YOUR PLAYER — Pick your position, build and country, then roll your CLAN bloodline. 26 clans, each with stat gifts and a signature move.

⚽ SURVIVE THE SELECTIONS — Beat every stage or get sent home. Duel your Master. Answer your nation's call and lift the World Cup.

🔥 EGO IS EVERYTHING — Spend ego on clutch plays. Roll Egoist Weapons, refine duplicates, and unlock the 5 Legendary weapons through pure skill on the pitch.

💍 BUILD A DYNASTY — Marry, raise heirs, retire a legend. Your child carries your legacy and part of your fortune. The bloodline continues.

💎 Agents, sponsors, fame and global leaderboards.
